context: M22 o1. Corwin lobby, 21:00. Every resident around Hollis's radio on the desk. Invented narration; no real voice or name.

lines.speaker: npc.radio_crowd
lines.text: (Radio) …the President, speaking tonight from the White House, has announced…

lines.speaker: npc.radio_crowd
lines.text: (Radio) …that he will resign the office, effective at noon tomorrow…

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: Well. I lived to see that. Walter would've had a speech about it.

lines.speaker: char.bernard_ostrow
lines.text: If a President can be read out of office, Mr. Arce, so can a lawyer.

lines.speaker: char.manny_soto
lines.text: Teddy. Phone. It's Mayhew. He sounds like he's underwater.
